citations.M2: new pod's `INSERT` never sets `status` at all ... fix by dual-writing both columns until 0143 drops the old one
citations.M3: `Order.from_row` calls `OrderState(row["state"])` with no None-handling — any order whose `state` is still NULL (every unbackfilled row, right after step 2 deploys) raises immediately
citations.M4: prod has `PAID`, `canceled`, `complete`, and NULL status (7,764 rows per the query in the description) — those rows get `state = NULL` forever
citations.M5: the `WHERE state IS NULL` set it's paging over shrinks with every UPDATE — OFFSET silently skips whole batches of never-processed rows; fix by keyset pagination
citations.M6: The whole backfill runs inside one `conn.transaction()` wrapping every batch ... any mid-run failure loses all progress; fix by committing per batch, not once at the end.
citations.M7: `jobs/nightly_finance_export.py` still reads `o.status` and filters on it, but the author's grep was scoped to `app/` and missed `jobs/`
citations.M8: assert `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE state IS NULL` returns 0 (and reconcile any stragglers) — the plan currently goes straight from "run backfill" to "drop status," with no verification gate
citations.M11: at staging's measured rate (11 min / 2.1M rows) prod's 61M rows is ~5+ hours in a single open transaction
citations.M12: it's a blocking full-table scan under `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` on 61M rows — fix by using a `NOT VALID` check constraint + `VALIDATE CONSTRAINT` first
